content.short: DSCVR is a decentralized social content aggregation platform where users control the content and the platform.
content.description: DSCVR is a decentralized social content aggregation platform where users have control over both the content and the platform itself. It shifts influence from a central authority to the community, giving the people who love, use, and care about DSCVR the power to shape its future. By placing governance in the hands of its most active participants, DSCVR enables a more communal, participatory model where the community ultimately steers what the platform becomes.
